p1_b1.ocr: Figure 1 Healthcare Pathway of an AS Patient. Each shape indicates a separate event (date) captured in the relevant datasets. The X-axis captures events for a period of two years (i.e. 730 days). Therefore, the GP event markers appear almost overlapped when events occurred in two consecutive dates (e.g. 31st August and 1st September). The questionnaire completion date is 05 November, 2009. The three month patient recall period is captured by the two vertical dashed lines, indicating the dates 07 August and 05 November. There are 10 GP events during this time interval, including the overlapped ones.
